thread:
hannah: Quick design huddle on the resource-usage chart. Two main pain points from support: axis labels are ambiguous (units switching without note) and spikes get completely flattened by our clamp. need proposals.
rick: yes — users expect stable units across dashboards. propose an explicit unit toggle (+ auto) next to axis title: "Units: auto | ms | s | raw". default auto but show small badge when auto changed units: "auto -> ms".
mina: unit toggle good. also recommend visually pinning the unit on the y-axis (right-aligned) so it's always in view when scrolling/small screens. current layout loses it.
theo: on clipping, ops complained they missed debugging cues. suggestion: draw a chevron glyph on the axis at the clip boundary and a faint dashed line to indicate where values were removed. hover shows a summary: "N values > 10s clipped (max shown 10s)".
hannah: I like the chevron + dashed line. make the chevron have aria-label "outliers clipped above 10s" and keyboard focus so screen readers can open the list.
a11y-bot: Reminder: ensure the chevron is reachable via tab order and role=button with aria-haspopup=dialog for details. Also announce changes via aria-live when clipping state changes.
rick: UX nit: when legend is collapsed into a single row for narrow screens, keyboard users lose the per-series toggle. proposal: collapsed state becomes an accessible combobox. left/right for selection, space to toggle. add a visible focus ring.
mina: for tooltips, current string "value: 1234567" should become "value  1.23 s (raw: 1234567)" with the raw value on a secondary line in monospace. add a tiny copy icon that copies raw. set tooltip to role=dialog when focused for screen readers.
theo: smoothing: when smoothing is applied, add a small pill inside tooltip header: "smoothed  window=3m". also include a toggle in quick controls to temporarily disable smoothing for the hovered point (helpful for debugging).
hannah: copy language: keep short verbs. examples for p95 tooltip: "p95 latency  1.23 s (raw: 1234567)" or "p95  1.23 s \u2014 raw: 1234567". prefer the first for clarity.
rick: Implementation detail for formatters: reuse formatNumber with thresholds. sample pseudocode: ```js
function prettyLatency(us){
  if(us>=1e6) return (us/1e6).toFixed(2)+" s";
  if(us>=1000) return (us/1000).toFixed(2)+" ms";
  return us+" \u00b5s";
}
```
mina: Axis ticks: stop auto abbreviating with mixed precision. rule: for k use one decimal (1.2k), for M use no decimal unless value <10M then one decimal (3.4M). I'll draft rules and examples.
theo: Accessibility: when the unit toggle changes chart scale, announce: "y-axis unit changed to milliseconds. ticks updated." via polite aria-live. Also allow a setting to keep units fixed per dashboard.
a11y-bot: Add to checklist: legend combobox nav, chevron button focusable, tooltip role, aria-live for unit/clip changes, copy button accessible.
hannah: Edge case: when we persist clip state in url (e.g., ?clip=10s) include a short fragment for screen reader: "Outliers clipped at 10s (click for details)".
rick: frontend note: decorations (chevron/dashed line/pill) should be a separate SVG layer so we can toggle via CSS and avoid repainting the main canvas. I'll add a tiny prototype in Figma and a CSS example: `.chart-decoration { pointer-events: auto; } .chevron:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus) }`.
mina: QA ask: verify NVDA + VoiceOver read tooltip header, formatted value, and raw line. Also check that copy-to-clipboard works with keyboard-only.
theo: timeline: i'll mock the chevron + pill and the unit toggle by EOW. hannah can write the copy options; mina will post the axis-abbrev rules. a11y-bot: create tickets.
a11y-bot: Created tasks: #DES-602 unit toggle + pin, #DES-603 clip chevron + dialog, #A11Y-121 tooltip semantics + copy.
hannah: thanks team. i'll consolidate copy variants and post to the design board once Theo shares mocks. :white_check_mark:
